definitions.gloss: mixed blood; mixed race; mixed heritage
definitions.explanation: Having parents of different racial or ethnic backgrounds. Can refer to the state of being mixed-race or to a person of mixed heritage.

examples.japanese: {混血|こんけつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子|こ}ども。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦フランス{人|じん}→フランス人：25089_furansujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{混血|こんけつ}だ。
examples.english: She is of mixed Japanese and French heritage.

examples.japanese: {混血|こんけつ}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦アイデンティティ→アイデンティティ：10688_aidentiti⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{誇|ほこ}り→誇り：03623_hokori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: She takes pride in her mixed heritage as part of her identity.

notes:
USAGE: The word now sounds dated and clinical when used of people; {混血|こんけつ}{児|じ} (mixed-race child) was common in post-war writing. In biology it also means crossbreeding.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ハーフ: a person with one Japanese and one non-Japanese parent — the usual everyday word, though some find it reductive
- ⟦ダブル→ダブル：24220_daburu⟧: "double" — preferred by some as a positive alternative to ハーフ
